name: llamaparse-marketplace
description: Connect your agents to the entire LlamaParse stack, from local parsing with LiteParse to cloud-powered workflows with LlamaParse and its MCP

plugins.name: liteparse
plugins.description: Parse unstructured documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images, and more) locally with LiteParse: fast, lightweight, no cloud dependencies or LLM required.

plugins.name: llamaparse
plugins.description: Parse is an agentic document parser for LLM pipelines—130+ file types, layout-aware, outputs clean markdown, text, or JSON.

plugins.name: llamaparse-mcp
plugins.description: Connect your agent to the LlamaParse Platform MCP and unlock access to document processing tools like Parse, Split and Classify, plus agentic retrieval over Index v2 knowledge bases.

plugins.name: llamaparse-mcp-eu
plugins.description: Connect your agent to the LlamaParse Platform MCP in the Europe region and unlock access to document processing tools like Parse, Split and Classify, plus agentic retrieval over Index v2 knowledge bases. Use this plugin if your LlamaCloud account lives on cloud.eu.llamaindex.ai; accounts on cloud.llamaindex.ai should install llamaparse-mcp instead.
